newsitem.title: UK: ICI slips after Australian unit's warning.
newsitem.headline: ICI slips after Australian unit's warning.

text.p: Shares in chemical giant ICI slipped in early trading on Thursday after ICI Australia Ltd said its full year profits were likely to be below the 1994/95 figure, traders said.
ICI shares in London were trading 9-1/2p lower at 866p shortly after the opening.

Shares in the Australian company have risen in recent days amid talk that its UK parent may launch a bid to mop up the 37.5 percent it does not already own. ICI Australia has said it does not know of any reason for the recent strength in its share price.

"The warning does imply a not very good second half but it's not out of line with what the company has been saying about the trend in Australia, but its not a big part of group profits," said ana analyst.
